subject: CALL-CONVENTION directive
notes: Rule: 'The CALL-CONVENTION directive may also be used by the implementor to determine other details needed to interact with a function, method, or program.' (cite.py OK §7.3.9.3 3)). Permissive ('may'): it grants the implementor latitude and imposes no obligation. WiseOwl COBOL uses no call-convention to select linkage details (single .NET managed calling convention, docs/CONFORMANCE.md recognized-and-ignored directives entry; DirectiveStateRegistry 'NONE HELD'). Declining an optional latitude conforms. Nothing observable to test.
